truth (Δ1): a -ux part that only reads (gets, list adds, a JSON builder) has nothing to save, and a write with a
Context in the -rt part is the -rt logic's business, not the dashboard's: no row, exit 0.

-- Mod/Mod-ux/src/com/x/ux/BReadServlet.java --
package com.x.ux;
public final class BReadServlet extends BWebServlet {
  public void doGet(WebOp op) {
    java.util.List<String> out = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
    out.add(point.get("out").toString());
    reply(op, out);
  }
}
-- Mod/Mod-rt/src/com/x/BLogic.java --
package com.x;
public final class BLogic extends BComponent {
  void apply(BValue v, Context cx) { set("out", v, cx); }
}
